title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 199
paragraphs: From this river Melas the city of Trachis is five furlongs distant; and here, in the area where Trachis stands, is the widest part of the whole district as regards the space from the mountains to the sea, the plain measuring 22,000 plethra. In the mountain range that encloses the land of Trachis there is a cleft to the south of Trachis itself; and through this cleft the river Asopos flows, running along the foot of the mountain.
